name: app/input
title: Input
summary: A native <input> at app density (36px, 48px and 16px text on touch). Every attribute except class passes through.

divergences: Height: the registry input is 48px everywhere; the app Input is 36px with a fine pointer.

props.name: ...attributes
props.description: Passed through: name, type, value, required, autocomplete, aria-*.

behaviour: Renders exactly the attributes given, plus data-slot and the classes.

aria: The caller labels it (Label or aria-label).

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`. Nothing else changes: layout, spacing, type and every other colour are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.
